title: Proposal Intake
subtitle: One Proposal identity from client inputs through Engineering and Contract Handoff.
primary_identity: Proposal reference + description; Opportunity Ref is secondary/provisional context
empty_state: No Proposal records match the current filter. Create a draft to begin the controlled source flow.
error_state: Controlled error with retry; never render zero data as success.

role_behavior.business_development: create intake, add sources/notes, proceed, commercial review
role_behavior.engineering: read same Proposal after handoff; technical preparation only
role_behavior.owner: business-readable visibility and configured approval capability
